description: Award results of up to 10 tenders at once, by public slug (from search_archived_tenders or any other listing) — to compare prices of similar past tenders. For each: title, contracting authority, estimated value, submission deadline, public URL, and the same award results get_tender returns (winner, value, number of offers, offer price band, the winner's own offer price, rejected offers, whether the cheapest offer won), without the AI summary. `results` is empty when no award is known; `found` is false for a slug that is not public.
name: get_tender_results
title: Wyniki przetargów
